evidence_boundary: No exact q=93 lower bound or attained optimum was produced, so no preregistered pair label is assigned. The run is only an operational scaling observation.
stop_reason: The first HiGHS dual-candidate solve reached its 600-second limit without a replayable bound. The adapter then exposed that its time limit was per presolve variant; the unintended second attempt was externally terminated and the adapter was corrected to enforce one global budget.
